root_cause: CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race exercises concurrent model loads through a MULTI/AUTO device and asserts a mocked plugin's import_model is invoked an exact number of times. On the Windows runner this is a well-known timing-sensitive race: thread scheduling occasionally lets one of the concurrent load_network calls return before its import_model call completes/registers, so the gmock expectation (7 calls) observes only 6. This is a pre-existing test flakiness unrelated to the PR under test (#39616 only touches the GPU reorder_data_fast_b1 kernel and its unit test); this exact signature has recurred 10 times since 2026-07-13 across unrelated PRs.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible outside CI; requires Windows runner timing conditions. Locally, repeatedly run `ov_inference_functional_tests --gtest_filter=CachingTest*LoadMultiWithConfig_race*` under load on a Windows machine to attempt reproduction; a tight loop may eventually surface the same gmock call-count mismatch.
recommended_actions: Make CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race deterministic: replace the exact EXPECT_CALL count assertion with a synchronization barrier (e.g., a condition variable or atomic counter with a wait/timeout) so the test does not depend on background thread scheduling completing within the measurement window.

Consider using EXPECT_CALL(...).Times(AtLeast(N)) or waiting on all async load futures to complete before verifying mock expectations, matching the pattern already fixed for sibling tests if any exist.
For this run: no code fix is required on PR #39616; simply re-run the failed job (the PR's own changes are unrelated to inference/tests/functional/caching_test.cpp).
prevention_strategies: Track and prioritize fixing src/inference/tests/functional/caching_test.cpp race-prone parameterized cases (LoadMulti_race, LoadMultiWithConfig_race) since they have now recurred 10+ times in the merge-queue pattern database; consider marking them disabled or quarantined until a deterministic rewrite lands, to stop blocking unrelated merge-queue PRs.
